about: Where Coral shows an agent's name and whether the shared helper (static/agent_link.js: the name as written, a button to its chat when it runs, plain text with a tooltip when it is gone) draws it (#12168, the operator: 'make that a common thing throughout Coral'). agent_name_census.test.mjs fails when a converted site stops using the helper, and when a pending site starts using it without being moved here. A site is a file and what in it names an agent.

converted.what: the author name and avatar of an agent's comment or reply (files)
the 'Sent to <agent> (...)' line under a comment, names as written
Needs you rows: 'From <agent>' on a review row, a question row and the phone's metadata line
board messages' author names in the Board tab and the board panel
an agent's permission card title: '<agent> asks you'
a goal's driver on the goal page
'Waiting for <assignee> to pick it up' on a team's task page

pending.what: a file's uploader on a review row and in the viewer title line
task tables: owner and reviewers are circles drawn by data_table.js (avatars/personButton), at start: they need the helper in the table, not here
a task's page: assigned to, created by, reviewers
the Agents tab's rows: the name is the row's own button (DT.avatar + primaryButton)
Analytics tables: By agent, tool and API calls
toasts and notices that name an agent
